remarks: Pristine, completely remodeled top floor 1-2 Bedroom, 1.5 Bath unit in prime mid city location. Step into this gorgeous kitchen with all new SS appls and black granite countertops with a beautiful breakfast bar that opens to dramatic open floor plan combining Dining area flowing into Living Room with wood burning fireplace, soaring ceilings and skylight.  Ensuite Primary Bedroom on main level with large walk-in closet, plus 2 additional large closets and a brand new full bath with tub. Laundry and powder room are also on main level.  Spiral staircase leads to a large loft bringing you to another room with large walk-in closet which could be used as a 2nd Bedroom/office/rec room. Additionally there is access to a very large walk in attic for amazing storage.  Features include - C/AC, all new hardwood floors, recessed lighting and plenty of storage.   Bldg. features elevator, common area room plus gated reserved parking.  Convenient location - walk to everything - downtown and nearby health clubs. Plenty of street parking and guest parking!
